verdict.rationale: AutoGen docs mention 'Logging: Log traces and internal messages' and AutoGen Studio provides an interactive UI for running/testing teams with run control, but there's no concrete evidence of a dedicated observability UI that traces individual LLM calls and tool invocations in detail (e.g., no mention of integration with tracing tools like OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, or a dedicated trace viewer). missing for 10: evidence of a full trace/span UI showing per-LLM-call and per-tool-call detail, integration with standard observability backends, and independent confirmation of this capability in use.
